constructor.details: Call path: Deploy._deployBusiness -> UserDashboard.constructor. All business dependencies must be deployed contracts; the dashboard itself does not custody assets or modify downstream state.

params.account: Account whose activation timestamp is queried.

returns.activatedAt: Unix timestamp of the first real activation, or zero.

params.limit: Maximum number of cards to return, from 1 to MAX_PAGE_SIZE.

returns.nextOffset: Offset for the next page, capped at the total count.

params.account: Inviter whose direct referrals are queried.
params.limit: Maximum number of addresses to return, from 1 to MAX_PAGE_SIZE.

returns.nextOffset: Offset for the next page, capped at the total count.

getDynamicRewardRecords(address,uint256,.details: Call path: DApp -> UserDashboard.getDynamicRewardRecords -> UserDashboard._validatePageSize -> RewardDistributor.rewardRecordCount/getRewardRecords. V3/V4 sale-fee index rewards are intentionally excluded from this record stream.

params.limit: Maximum number of records to return, from 1 to MAX_PAGE_SIZE.

returns.nextOffset: Offset for the next page, capped at the total count.

params.account: Account whose recorded reward totals are queried.

returns.totals: Historical direct, level and team totals.

params.offset: Zero-based history offset at which scanning starts.
params.scanLimit: Number of history entries to scan, from 1 to MAX_PAGE_SIZE; fewer exited cards may be returned.

returns.cards: Exited cards found in the scanned range.
returns.nextOffset: Next history offset, regardless of how many exited cards were found.

getGradeSalePendingUsdt(address).details: Combines pendingGradeSaleUsdt already settled across prior grades with the account's single currently active V3/V4 index. Call path: DApp -> UserDashboard.getGradeSalePendingUsdt -> RewardDistributor.pendingGradeSaleUsdt/activeSaleGrade/gradeAccounts/accSaleUsdtPerMember.

params.account: Account whose current V3/V4 sale-fee reward is queried.

returns.amount: Current unclaimed V3/V4 sale-fee USDT in the token's smallest unit.

getOrganizationRewardRecords(address,uin.details: Call path: DApp -> UserDashboard.getOrganizationRewardRecords -> UserDashboard._validatePageSize -> OrganizationBenefit.rewardRecordCount/getRewardRecords. This read-only method does not change reward accounting.

params.account: Account whose organization reward records are queried.
params.limit: Number of records to return, from 1 to MAX_PAGE_SIZE.

returns.nextOffset: Offset for the next page; equals the total record count when the end is reached.
returns.records: Existing organization reward records in account insertion order.

getPositionEarnings(uint256).details: Call path: DApp -> UserDashboard.getPositionEarnings -> MiningSystem.earningsLedger -> MiningEarningsLedger.earningsStatus/previewConsumeRange -> PriceOracle.quoteUsdtToMobSpot. The EarningsStatus fields remain uncapped historical ledger values; withdrawal and composition previews use the same remaining exit capacity and oldest-first consumption rules as MiningSystem execution, and become zero after the position exits.

getTradingModeDiagnosis().details: Call path: DApp -> UserDashboard.getTradingModeDiagnosis -> TradingModeController.getTradingModeStatus/switchedAt/config getters -> InteractionPool switch-multiplier getters. Uses only bounded constant-time reads and never changes mode state.

returns.diagnosis: Raw mode status plus the settings and calculated targets relevant to the active switch reason.

getUserOverview(address).details: Call path: DApp -> UserDashboard.getUserOverview -> ReferralRegistry/MiningSystem/ MiningEarningsSettlement/RewardDistributor/OrganizationBenefit/NodeRewardPool/TeamPerformance/TradingRouter. The only loop covers the four fixed node types; no growing user or history array is traversed.

params.account: Account whose balances, rewards, team data and sale allowance are queried.

returns.overview: Current account summary; workingMobSellLimitUsdt is the historical maximum-card single-sale cap.

params.cursorPositionId: Zero to start at the FIFO head, otherwise the next working position to read.
params.limit: Maximum number of cards to return, from 1 to MAX_PAGE_SIZE.

returns.nextCursor: Next working position, or zero at the end.

params.account: Account whose dynamic-reward eligibility is queried.

returns.eligible: True only while both conditions are satisfied.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

constructor.notice: Creates the read-only dashboard implementation with immutable business-contract dependencies.

firstActivationAt(address).notice: Returns the account's first real mining-card activation timestamp, or zero for legacy-only accounts.

getCardHistory(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Returns one offset-based page of all positions in creation order.

getDirectReferrals(address,uint256,uint2.notice: Returns one offset-based page of permanently bound direct referrals.

getDynamicRewardRecords(address,uint256,.notice: Returns one page of ordinary direct, level and team reward records.

getDynamicRewardTotals(address).notice: Returns historical ordinary dynamic reward totals by kind. Call path: DApp -> UserDashboard.getDynamicRewardTotals -> RewardDistributor.cumulativeRewardByKind. V3/V4 sale-fee index rewards are intentionally absent and gradeSaleUsdt remains zero.

getExitedCards(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Scans one bounded history page and returns only positions that have exited.

getGradeSalePendingUsdt(address).notice: Returns the current unclaimed V3/V4 sale-fee USDT for an account.

getNcnSellQualification(address).notice: Returns the complete cumulative NCN trading qualification currently applied to MÖB sales.

getOrganizationRewardRecords(address,uin.notice: Returns paginated organization-card USDT reward records from the existing benefit ledger.

getPositionAccelerationStatus(uint256).notice: Returns one position's current acceleration principal, latest stake cycle, restake availability, and global principal.

getPositionEarnings(uint256).notice: Returns one position's complete cumulative ledger and executable-cap-aware MÖB previews.

getTradingModeDiagnosis().notice: Returns the current trading-mode reason, operator settings, exact recovery targets, and remaining gaps.

getUserOverview(address).notice: Returns the bounded account overview used by the DApp dashboard.

getWorkingCards(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Returns one cursor-based page of currently working cards in FIFO order.

isRewardEligible(address).notice: Returns whether the account currently has a working card and an unexpired mint-fee period.
